Record Class SecurityChartPdfComposer.Row

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.report.pdf.SecurityChartPdfComposer.Row
Record Components:
number - the number printed at its marker in the chart, null for the hypothetical sale, which has no marker
date - booking date; for the hypothetical sale the day of the valuation
typeKey - name of the transaction type, translated through the message bundle
units - units of the transaction, null for a booking without units
price - price per unit in the security currency, null for a booking without price
amount - amount on the cash account in the currency of that account, null when not booked
currency - currency of the cash account
gain - gain or loss of the row in the security currency, null where the row has none
gainPercentage - the gain in percent of the cost, null where the row has none
splitAdjusted - whether the marker sits at a split-adjusted price that differs from the booked price
gainIncomplete - whether the purchases did not cover the sale, so that the gain lacks the missing units
hypothetical - whether this is the hypothetical sale of the open position
estimateIncomplete - whether the estimated costs of the hypothetical sale lack a fee model, a tax model or a matching rule
Enclosing class:
SecurityChartPdfComposer
public static record SecurityChartPdfComposer.Row(Integer number, LocalDate date, String typeKey, Double units, Double price, Double amount, String currency, Double gain, Double gainPercentage, boolean splitAdjusted, boolean gainIncomplete, boolean hypothetical, boolean estimateIncomplete) extends Record
A row of the table: a transaction of the chart, or the hypothetical sale of the open position.
